notes: Self-contained bundle for vllm_tt_plugin.platform.register_tt_models() -> _register_models_from_extra_dir(). Point EXTRA_MODELS_DIR at the parent vllm_bundle/ directory. 'arch' is this checkpoint's config.json architecture; the plugin prefixes it with TT. 'main_class' resolves through the sibling shim module, which is importable because the plugin appends this folder to sys.path. Single Blackhole die (MESH_DEVICE=P150), one image per request, batch 1.
